article_content: By Darren Boyle. Iran has reduced its nuclear stockpile by nearly 75 percent, according to the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA). The IAEA has spent the past six months investigating whether the Tehran regime has complied with international obligations. In a report to the United Nations, the IAEA confirmed that Iran halted aspects of its nuclear program on January 20, opening the possibility for easing international sanctions. New Iranian President Hassan Rouhani is seen as far more moderate than his predecessor. As a result of Iran's compliance with the agreement, Tehran may now access foreign currency reserves frozen since the dispute arose. The IAEA confirmed that Iran has diluted half of its higher-grade enriched uranium reserve to a level that cannot be used to build a nuclear weapon. Over the past three months, Iran has diluted 155kg of higher-grade uranium gas, less than the 250kg necessary to build a bomb. As a result of Iran's compliance, the U.S. government has begun moves to release $450 million of Iranian funds frozen since the crisis began. Western governments had feared that former Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad wanted the country to develop nuclear weapons. In April 2008, Ahmadinejad visited the Natanz Uranium Enrichment facility. According to State Department spokeswoman Marie Harf, all sides have kept the commitments made as part of the agreement. Western diplomatic sources indicate that Hassan Rouhani's election as president has enabled progress, following years of strife under Ahmadinejad. Experts say that Iran now has significantly less 20-percent enriched uranium required for building a nuclear warhead. Last year, Iran had almost 200kg of this material, close to the 250kg threshold needed to construct a bomb. Western governments feared that Iran's pursuit of a nuclear deterrent could lead to further instability in the Middle East.
translated_content: Na Darren Boyle. Iran imepunguza akiba yake ya nyuklia kwa takriban asilimia 75, kulingana na Shirika la Kimataifa la Nishati ya Atomiki (IAEA). IAEA imetumia miezi sita iliyopita kuchunguza ikiwa utawala wa Tehran umezingatia majukumu ya kimataifa. Katika ripoti kwa Umoja wa Mataifa, IAEA ilithibitisha kwamba Iran ilisitisha baadhi ya vipengele vya mpango wake wa nyuklia mnamo Januari 20, na hivyo kufungua uwezekano wa kupunguza vikwazo vya kimataifa. Rais mpya wa Iran, Hassan Rouhani, anachukuliwa kuwa mpole zaidi ikilinganishwa na mtangulizi wake. Kutokana na utiifu wa Iran kwa makubaliano hayo, Tehran sasa inaweza kupata akiba ya fedha za kigeni zilizofungiwa tangu mzozo ulipoanza. IAEA ilithibitisha kwamba Iran imepunguza nusu ya shehena yake ya urani iliyoboreshwa zaidi hadi kiwango ambacho hakiwezi kutumika kutengeneza silaha ya nyuklia. Katika miezi mitatu iliyopita, Iran imepunguza kilo 155 za gesi ya urani yenye ubora wa juu, chini ya kilo 250 zinazohitajika kutengeneza bomu. Kufuatia utiifu wa Iran, serikali ya Marekani imeanza mchakato wa kuachilia dola milioni 450 za fedha za Iran zilizofungiwa tangu mgogoro ulipoanza. Serikali za Magharibi ziliogopa kwamba rais wa zamani wa Iran, Mahmoud Ahmadinejad, alitaka nchi hiyo kutengeneza silaha za nyuklia. Mwezi Aprili 2008, Ahmadinejad alitembelea kituo cha kurutubisha urani cha Natanz. Kulingana na msemaji wa Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje ya Marekani, Marie Harf, pande zote zimeheshimu ahadi zilizowekwa kama sehemu ya makubaliano hayo. Vyanzo vya kidiplomasia vya Magharibi vinaonyesha kwamba kuchaguliwa kwa Hassan Rouhani kama rais kumewezesha maendeleo, kufuatia miaka ya mivutano chini ya Ahmadinejad. Wataalamu wanasema kwamba sasa Iran ina kiwango kidogo zaidi cha urani yenye ubora wa asilimia 20 kinachohitajika kutengeneza kichwa cha kombora cha nyuklia. Mwaka jana, Iran ilikuwa na karibu kilo 200 za nyenzo hii, karibu na kiwango cha kilo 250 kinachohitajika kutengeneza bomu. Serikali za Magharibi ziliogopa kwamba jitihada za Iran za kuunda silaha za nyuklia zinaweza kusababisha hali isiyo tulivu zaidi katika Mashariki ya Kati.

article_content: 'James Sallis may be the best crime writer you have never heard of. Over an award-winning career spanning almost forty years, he has written more than two dozen works of fiction, poetry, essays, criticism, and biography, building a small yet devoted following. Now that following is about to grow dramatically.' 'His newest novel, 'The Killer is Dying,' is earning praise worldwide, while his 2005 noir classic, 'Drive,' hits the big screen this week. 'Drive' boasts an all-star cast, including Ryan Gosling as a stunt driver for movies by day who drives for criminals at night. Danish director Nicolas Winding Refn won Best Director at Cannes for 'Drive' earlier this year.' 'Sallis's novel 'The Killer is Dying' involves three strangers in Phoenix: Christian, a dying hit man on his final job; Sayles, a detective trying to catch him; and Jimmie, a teenager abandoned by his parents who somehow shares Christian's dreams. The novel offers minimalist noir with a cinematic feel—pulp fiction for the 21st century.' 'Beyond writing, Sallis is also a poet, professor, and musician. CNN recently spoke with him about his new novel, and he provided insights into his work in a brief conversation.' 'Asked to describe 'The Killer is Dying,' Sallis calls it a story of three isolated people in a huge makeshift city in the desert who ultimately find a form of community. Christian is hired to kill but is beaten to his target by someone else, while Sayles, unaware of Christian, investigates the attack. Meanwhile, Jimmie is a resourceful teenager suddenly experiencing Christian's dreams.' 'Phoenix, as portrayed in the book, is diverse, sprawling, and seemingly triumphing over the desert environment. Sallis also draws on his other creative roles—poet, translator, biographer, musician, and teacher. He claims that removing any one of these aspects would change his work entirely.' 'When asked about becoming a writer, Sallis says he knew from an early age that writing was inevitable. He references noir fiction's sense of inevitable fate, which resonates within his creative outlook.' 'His popular novel 'Drive' has been adapted into a Hollywood film, though Sallis was not involved in the adaptation beyond providing the source material. He praises the film as an outstanding work featuring Ryan Gosling's acting and Albert Brooks as a notable antagonist.' 'Recent reads that impressed him include Barry Hannah's 'Long, Last, Happy,' Daniel Woodrell's 'The Bayou Trilogy,' and 'The Collected Stories of Carol Emshwiller.' Sallis is currently over a hundred pages into a sequel to 'Drive,' and also revising the manuscript of 'Others of My Kind.' Outside of writing, he performs with his band Three-Legged Dog.'
translated_content: 'James Sallis huenda akawa mwandishi bora wa riwaya za uhalifu ambaye hujawahi kumsikia. Katika taaluma ya takriban miaka arobaini ya kushinda tuzo, ameandika vitabu zaidi ya viwili vya hadithi, mashairi, insha, ukosoaji, na wasifu, akipata kundi dogo linalompenda. Sasa anaongeza umaarufu wake.' 'Riwaya yake mpya, 'The Killer is Dying,' imepokea sifa dunia nzima, wakati riwaya yake ya noir ya 2005, 'Drive,' inafika kwenye skrini za filamu wiki hii. 'Drive' inajumuisha waigizaji mashuhuri, akiwemo Ryan Gosling kama dereva wa filamu asubuhi na dereva wa wahalifu usiku. Mkurugenzi raia wa Denmark Nicolas Winding Refn alishinda Tuzo ya Mkurugenzi Bora huko Cannes kupitia 'Drive' mapema mwaka huu.' 'Riwaya ya 'The Killer is Dying' inawashirikisha Christian, muuaji anayekaribia kufa; Sayles, afisa upelelezi anayemfuatilia; na Jimmie, kijana aliyeachwa na wazazi wake ambaye kwa namna fulani anaota ndoto za Christian. Ni mtazamo wa noir minimalist wenye hali ya filamu — fasihi ya pulp ya karne ya 21.' 'Mbali na uandishi, Sallis ni mshairi, profesa, na mwanamuziki. CNN ilizungumza naye hivi karibuni kuhusu riwaya yake mpya, ambapo alitoa uchambuzi mfupi wa kazi yake.' 'Sallis anasema 'The Killer is Dying' ni kuhusu watu watatu waliotengwa mjini kubwa lililojengwa jangwani, ambao hatimaye wanapata jamii ya aina fulani. Christian anaenda kutekeleza mauaji lakini shabaha inauawa na mtu mwingine, wakati Sayles, asiyemfahamu Christian, anachunguza tukio hilo. Jimmie ni kijana anayejipatia kipato kupitia eBay na kupata ndoto za Christian.' 'Kuhusu Phoenix, Sallis anaelezea mji huo kama eneo tofauti, linalopanuka na kushinda changamoto za jangwa. Anaeleza kwamba uandishi, mashairi, utafsiri, ubaiolojia, muziki, na ualimu, vyote vina mchango muhimu katika kazi zake.' 'Alipoulizwa kama alitaka kuwa mwandishi siku zote, Sallis anasema alitambua mapema sana mustakabali wake. Anarejelea mtazamo wa hatima isiyozuilika katika fasihi ya noir.' 'Riwaya yake maarufu 'Drive' sasa ni filamu ya Hollywood. Sallis hakuhusika kikamilifu katika mchakato wa kutengeneza filamu lakini anaisifu kuwa kazi bora, akitaja uigizaji wa Gosling na mhusika mbaya wa Albert Brooks.' 'Miongoni mwa vitabu vilivyomvutia ni 'Long, Last, Happy' (Barry Hannah), 'The Bayou Trilogy' (Daniel Woodrell), na 'The Collected Stories of Carol Emshwiller.' Sallis yuko zaidi ya kurasa mia moja kuendeleza riwaya ya pili ya 'Drive' na kurekebisha 'Others of My Kind.' Pia anapiga muziki na bendi yake Three-Legged Dog.'

article_content: For 45 years, Charlie Hebdo has boldly satirized taboo subjects that mainstream publications often avoid. One of its founders, Henri Roussel, believes that former editor Stephane Charbonnier's 'pig-headed' insistence on satirizing Islam contributed to the attack that killed him and seven of his colleagues. Charbonnier, known as 'Charb,' was among 17 people killed in a terror spree in Paris last week, beginning with a massacre at Charlie Hebdo's offices. In a piece for Nouvel Obs, Roussel accuses Charbonnier of 'dragging the team' into danger by publishing increasingly provocative cartoons of the Prophet Muhammad. He wonders why Charb felt the need to push so hard, recalling the first time Charlie Hebdo featured the Prophet on its cover in 2011—an act that prompted threats and eventually an arson attack on its headquarters. Even Charbonnier's former partner, Jeanette Bougrab, feared he would be assassinated, saying she begged him to leave France. She noted that Charb never had children because he believed he would be killed one day. Roussel also mentions that fellow cartoonist Georges Wolinski expressed concerns about pushing boundaries too far. Richard Malka, Charlie Hebdo's lawyer for 22 years, denounced Roussel's remarks as inappropriate so soon after the tragedy. However, Nouvel Obs editor Matthieu Croissandeau defended publishing Roussel's perspective in the name of press freedom. Meanwhile, Charlie Hebdo's 'survivors' edition,' again depicting the Prophet Muhammad on its cover, generated unprecedented demand across Europe. Initial print runs sold out immediately, and additional copies were quickly ordered to meet the overwhelming show of solidarity and curiosity from readers.
translated_content: Kwa miaka 45, Charlie Hebdo limekuwa likitoa tashtiti kali kuhusu mada tata ambazo machapisho mengi huwa yanakwepa. Mmoja wa waanzilishi wake, Henri Roussel, anaamini kuwa msisitizo 'wa ukaidi' wa mhariri wa zamani Stephane Charbonnier juu ya kufanya mzaha kuhusu Uislamu ulichangia shambulio lililomuua yeye pamoja na wenzake saba. Charbonnier, anayejulikana kama 'Charb,' alikuwa miongoni mwa watu 17 waliouawa katika msururu wa mashambulio ya kigaidi jijini Paris wiki iliyopita, likiwemo tukio la mauaji kwenye ofisi za Charlie Hebdo. Katika makala ya Nouvel Obs, Roussel anamtuhumu Charbonnier kwa 'kuivuta timu' kwenye hatari kwa kuchapisha katuni zinazozidi kuzua utata za Mtume Muhammad. Anashangaa kwa nini Charb alihisi haja ya kusukuma mipaka kupita kiasi, akirejelea wakati wa kwanza ambapo Charlie Hebdo ilimwonyesha Mtume huyo kwenye jalada mwaka 2011—kitendo kilichosababisha vitisho na hatimaye shambulio la kuchomwa moto makao yake makuu. Hata aliyekuwa mwenzi wa Charbonnier, Jeanette Bougrab, aliogopa angeuawa, akisema alimrai aondoke Ufaransa. Alieleza kuwa Charb hakupata watoto kwa sababu aliamini angeuawa siku moja. Roussel pia anasema mchoraji katuni Georges Wolinski alikuwa na mashaka kuhusu kusukuma mipaka kupindukia. Richard Malka, wakili wa Charlie Hebdo kwa miaka 22, alilaani matamshi ya Roussel akisema hayafai wakati huu mfupi baada ya msiba huo. Hata hivyo, mhariri wa Nouvel Obs, Matthieu Croissandeau, alitetea uamuzi wa kuchapisha mtazamo wa Roussel kwa niaba ya uhuru wa vyombo vya habari. Wakati huo huo, 'survivors' edition' ya Charlie Hebdo, ikiwa na picha nyingine ya Mtume Muhammad kwenye jalada, ilileta msukumo mkubwa kote Ulaya. Nakala za kwanza ziliuzwa haraka, na nakala za ziada zikaagizwa mara moja kukidhi hamu na mshikamano wa wasomaji.

article_content: People who suspect they may have cancer will be able to bypass their GP and refer themselves for tests, aiming to save 8,000 lives a year. New proposals will allow GPs to send patients straight for scans, speeding up diagnosis. More than 60 hospitals in England will run pilot schemes focused on catching cancer earlier. NHS England says that a 10% increase in early detection would save 8,000 lives annually and reduce pressure on A&E units. David Cameron said Britain must never rest in its determination to beat cancer, as half of all cases are spotted late. A new NHS cancer taskforce will evaluate seven schemes to speed up diagnosis, including self-referral for tests. Radiologists support early testing but warn that more staff and resources are needed. Many patients wait over a month for results of crucial scans, highlighting resource shortages. Stereotactic ablative radiotherapy (Cyberknife) will receive extra funding, potentially doubling patient access. Cancer Research UK predicts that cases will rise by a third over the next 15 years, making early action crucial.
translated_content: Watu wanaohisi wanaweza kuwa na saratani wataweza kumwona daktari wa familia au kujielekeza wenyewe kwenye vipimo, wakilenga kuokoa maisha ya watu 8,000 kwa mwaka. Mapendekezo mapya yataruhusu madaktari wa familia kuwaelekeza wagonjwa moja kwa moja kwenye uchunguzi, hivyo kuharakisha utambuzi. Hospitali zaidi ya 60 nchini Uingereza zitaendesha mipango ya majaribio ili kugundua saratani mapema zaidi. NHS England inasema kwamba ongezeko la asilimia 10 katika kugundua ugonjwa mapema linaweza kuokoa maisha ya watu 8,000 kila mwaka na kupunguza msongamano katika vituo vya dharura. David Cameron alisema Uingereza haipaswi kupumzika kamwe katika azma yake ya kutokomeza saratani, kwani nusu ya kesi zote hugunduliwa ikiwa imechelewa. Kikosi kazi kipya cha saratani cha NHS kitakagua mipango saba ya kuharakisha utambuzi, ikiwemo utaratibu wa kujielekeza mwenyewe kwenye vipimo. Wataalamu wa radiolojia wanaunga mkono vipimo vya mapema lakini wanaonya kuwa kunahitajika wafanyakazi zaidi na rasilimali za kutosha. Wagonjwa wengi wanasubiri zaidi ya mwezi kupata matokeo ya vipimo muhimu, jambo linaloonyesha upungufu wa rasilimali. Mbinu ya tiba ya stereotactic ablative (Cyberknife) itapata fedha zaidi, hivyo kuongeza mara mbili idadi ya wagonjwa wanaoweza kufaidika. Cancer Research UK inakadiria kuwa kesi za saratani zitaongezeka kwa theluthi moja katika miaka 15 ijayo, na kufanya hatua za mapema kuwa muhimu.

article_content: ‘A 29-year-old Missouri man, Ryan Ferguson, has stepped out of prison after nearly ten years behind bars for a crime he maintains he never committed. He is determined to support the family of murder victim Kent Heitholt in finding real justice, although they still believe he is guilty.’ ‘Ferguson was only 19 when he was handed a 40-year sentence for the killing of Heitholt, a well-known sports editor in Columbia. Despite no physical evidence linking him to the scene, he was convicted based on two witnesses who later recanted their statements.’ ‘Since his release, Ferguson has pledged to pursue the same level of advocacy once shown by his father, Bill. Keith Morrison, an NBC Dateline correspondent who followed the case, noted that Ryan is driven by the injustice he endured and hopes the Heitholt family can discover the truth.’ ‘The victim’s widow, Deborah Evangelista, expressed ongoing sadness upon hearing Ferguson’s conviction had been overturned. She said it remains painful, but trusts that God will see true justice served in the end.’ ‘After leaving prison, Ryan returned to his hometown and found it much changed. He also visited his grandparents in Florida, a reunion he had doubted would ever happen. He and his family credited the unwavering support and belief among loved ones for his eventual exoneration.’ ‘Chuck Erikson, who originally implicated Ryan, has struggled with substance abuse and memory lapses, which Ferguson sees as significant factors in the false testimony. Despite it all, Ryan doesn’t hold resentment, calling Erikson equally undeserving of a wrongful conviction.’ ‘For years, Bill Ferguson fought relentlessly to clear his son’s name. The father’s unwavering motto was: “Don’t feel sorry for yourself. Be stronger, smarter, and stay focused on self-improvement.” Ryan followed this guidance, spending his prison time reading, studying, and promoting health among fellow inmates.’ ‘Now, at 29, Ryan grapples with everyday freedoms most people take for granted. From adjusting to updated technology like smartphones to reacquainting himself with his old neighborhood, he is learning how to live as a free man. For him, a new challenge is figuring out his life’s direction, now that he unexpectedly has it back.’
translated_content: ‘Baada ya kuhakiki tafsiri, maneno na dhana kuu zimefikishwa kwa usahihi. Lugha ni fasaha, na hakuna marekebisho makubwa yanayohitajika. Ujumbe umedumisha hisia, maelezo, na ukweli muhimu kama ilivyokusudiwa.’

article_content: Ms. Reardon, a young deaf woman, arrived for a scheduled job interview at a Darwin catering company, but found herself turned away because she could not speak English. Feeling let down by the rejection, she took her concern to the Northern Territory Anti-Discrimination Commission. According to Ms. Reardon, she tried communicating with the interviewer, Angela, by writing notes. However, Angela indicated there was not enough time to exchange written messages, insisting that staff needed someone who spoke English. Hurt by the refusal, Ms. Reardon left without being interviewed. She later explained that she holds valuable hospitality experience, including working in fast-paced kitchens and earning a hospitality certificate. The company did email an apology, but Ms. Reardon pointed out that it focused on language requirements rather than her professional capabilities. The owner insisted that she did not possess the required skills for the role, a stance Ms. Reardon believes overlooks her actual abilities.
translated_content: Bi. Reardon, mwanamke kiziwi kijana, aliwasili kwenye usaili uliopangwa katika kampuni ya upishi ya Darwin, lakini alikataliwa kwa sababu hakuweza kuzungumza Kiingereza. Akiwa amevunjika moyo na kitendo hicho, aliwasilisha malalamiko kwa Tume ya Kupinga Ubaguzi ya Northern Territory. Kwa maelezo ya Bi. Reardon, alijaribu kuwasiliana na mwajiriwa, Angela, kupitia maandishi. Hata hivyo, Angela alisisitiza kwamba hawakuwa na muda wa kubadilishana maandishi, akisema wafanyakazi wanahitaji mtu anayeongea Kiingereza. Akiwa amekuwa mwenye huzuni na kukataliwa huko, Bi. Reardon aliondoka bila kufanyiwa usaili. Baadaye, alieleza kwamba ana uzoefu mkubwa katika ukarimu, ikiwa ni pamoja na kufanya kazi katika jikoni zinazohudumia watu wengi na kutunukiwa cheti cha ukarimu. Kampuni ilituma barua-pepe ya kuomba radhi, lakini Bi. Reardon aliona ombi hilo likitilia mkazo uhitaji wa lugha badala ya uwezo wake kitaaluma. Mmiliki wa kampuni alidai kwamba hakuwa na ujuzi unaohitajika kwa kazi hiyo, jambo ambalo Bi. Reardon anaona kuwa ni kupuuza uwezo wake halisi.
